description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractCandidateActionAPI' within the OrangeHRM recruitment API module. It provides functionalities for handling candidate-related actions such as updating candidate status, recording history, and converting candidates to employees. The class uses traits and dependencies related to recruitment and core API components, and includes methods for validation, transaction management, and permission checks.

classes.name: AbstractCandidateActionAPI
classes.description: An abstract class providing base API operations for candidate actions within the recruitment module, including updating candidate status, managing candidate history, and converting candidates to employees, with permission and workflow checks.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Performs candidate status updates, manages transactions, enforces workflow rules, records history, and converts candidates to employees if needed.

methods.description: Provides validation rules for the update operation.
